intro: The KPK LsETH Carry Fund earns a carry on Liquid Collective's LsETH, on top of its ETH staking yield, through collateralised lending on Morpho. LsETH is supplied as collateral on the Morpho LsETH/USDC market, USDC is borrowed against it within a managed health factor band, and the proceeds are deployed into two KPK-curated USDC vaults on Morpho. Holders stay fully exposed to ETH and earn ETH staking yield plus the spread between stablecoin lending yields and borrow costs, with returns accruing in LsETH.
LsETH is Liquid Collective's liquid staking token for ETH. Approved platforms such as Figment and Kraken mint and redeem it, and it also trades on DEXes, where it can be bought and sold without KYC.
Deposits and redemptions are in LsETH. The fund runs on Upshift's vault infrastructure with KPK as curator, and KPK's agents adjust the loan around the clock as ETH moves.

backtest.summary: Backtest cross-check: +2.11% a year at 75% LTV over 180 days
backtest.text: Over the 180 days to 30 Jul 2026, on reconstructed onchain borrow rates and the vault's realised share price, this strategy at 75% LTV averaged +2.11% net over LsETH: monthly range 1.32% to 3.17%, with the 1.5% floor cleared on 75% of days. That run used deeper 86%-LLTV proxy markets, because LsETH/USDC had no rate history at the time; its own 45 days since have averaged 4.01% borrow at 89% utilisation, against the proxy's 4.01%.

health_factor_manager._readme: Live KPK Agents config for this position. The page converts each health factor to LTV at the market's live LLTV.

risk.title: Automated in a band, alerted on carry, bounded onchain
risk.lede: KPK runs the position with deterministic agents. They act only through onchain permissions and within the settings KPK gives them: when a predefined condition is met, they execute a predefined action. The health factor manager keeps the loan in its band; the other agents move LsETH between the vault and the trading subaccount and propose the NAV. Two exit agents, one per KPK USDC vault, withdraw the fund's USDC from a vault back to the trading subaccount when Hypernative flags that vault or a market it lends into. A negative carry goes to KPK's risk team for review.
steps: The agents read the position's health factor and the LsETH waiting in the vault. Hypernative watches the carry: the two vaults' yield against the LsETH/USDC borrow rate.

Rules set in advance. Inside the health factor band, {repay_below} to {borrow_above}, nothing happens. Outside it, the health factor manager acts. A negative spread raises an alert to KPK's risk team.
The agent sends the transaction itself: it repays to a health factor of {repay_to}, or borrows back to {borrow_to}, in steps of at least {min_change} USDC.

On the operator Safe, KPK's agents can call only the two LsETH transfer functions, through a Zodiac Roles module. NAV updates need KPK's and Upshift's signatures and stay within the vault owner's maximum change.

auto.title: The health factor manager and the exit agents
auto.body: Below a health factor of {repay_below} the agent repays to {repay_to}; above {borrow_above} it borrows back to {borrow_to} and deposits the new USDC {split_yield}/{split_rwa} into the two KPK USDC vaults, in steps of at least {min_change} USDC. At the market's {lltv} LLTV those levels are {repay_below_ltv}, {repay_to_ltv}, {borrow_to_ltv} and {borrow_above_ltv} LTV. The exit agents act in this layer too: on an exploit-class, pause or oracle alert on a market a KPK USDC vault lends into, or a vault-level alert (a gate change, an owner or curator change, or a share-price drop), the vault's exit agent withdraws the fund's USDC from that vault back to the trading subaccount.

human.title: Negative carry goes to the risk team
human.body: Hypernative watches the spread, the two vaults' share-price yield minus the LsETH/USDC borrow rate as a 6-hour median, and alerts KPK's risk team when it turns negative. The team reviews each alert.

agents.name: Health factor manager
agents.body: Keeps the position inside its band. Below a health factor of {repay_below} it repays to {repay_to}; above {borrow_above} it borrows back to {borrow_to}. Each change is at least {min_change} USDC, and new borrowing goes {split_yield}/{split_rwa} into KPK USDC Yield and KPK USDC Yield RWA.

agents.name: Deposit agents
agents.body: Move newly subscribed LsETH from the Upshift vault to the trading subaccount, and supply idle LsETH there as collateral on Morpho.

agents.name: Withdraw agent
agents.body: Moves LsETH back from the trading subaccount to the vault to pay redemptions.

agents.name: NAV agent
agents.short: proposes the NAV twice a week
agents.body: KPK's NAV Calculator gives the fund's NAV at every block, and anyone can query it onchain. The Upshift vault records it twice a week: the NAV agent checks it against an independent valuation and proposes the update on Mondays and Thursdays. Upshift co-signs each update, bounded by a maximum change set by the vault owner.

agents.name: Agents on the KPK USDC vaults
agents.body: Both KPK USDC vaults run KPK's rebalance, exit and monitoring agents, which exit a market on a pause, exploit or oracle change. They act on the vaults, not on the fund's own loan.

agents.name: Exit agents
agents.short: pull USDC out of a vault on an alert
agents.body: One per KPK USDC vault, each acting with no human approval needed. On an exploit-class, pause or oracle alert on a market the vault lends into, or a vault-level alert (a gate change, an owner or curator change, or a share-price drop), it withdraws the fund's USDC from that vault back to the trading subaccount.

permissions.title: Two parties own the vault
permissions.body: The vault owner is a 3-of-4 Safe with two KPK seats, the KPK curation Safe and the KPK Security Council, and two Upshift seats, so neither side can change the vault alone.

permissions.title: Only the operator moves LsETH
permissions.body: Moving LsETH between the vault and the trading subaccount, and writing the NAV, are reserved to the operator, a 2-of-2 Safe with one KPK and one Upshift signer. KPK's agents call only the two transfer functions, through a Zodiac Roles module on that Safe.

permissions.title: Both sides sign every NAV
permissions.body: Each NAV update needs both signatures and is bounded by a maximum change set by the vault owner.

tiles.detail: subscriptions, up to the vault's 10,000 LsETH cap
redemptions: instant against LsETH held in the vault; larger amounts once KPK moves LsETH back from the trading subaccount, normally within 2 days

terms.note: Subscribe in LsETH and redeem for LsETH, both at the last recorded share price. Subscribed LsETH is then moved to the trading subaccount and supplied as collateral.
